slides.texte_overlay:
5 things that will pull you out
of your dopamine addiction

a grayscale screen

switch your phone to grayscale for one week. the colours are designed to pull you back in, and without them your phone suddenly looks as boring as it really is.

the ten minute wait

when you feel the urge to grab your phone, set a timer for ten minutes and wait. most cravings fade before it rings, and your brain learns it doesn't need every hit.

slow rewards

spend 5 minutes a day learning something that takes effort: a word in a new language, a moment in history, a painting. slow rewards retrain a brain that only knows fast ones.
slides.texte_sophia:
slow rewards

i spend 5 minutes a day learning something that takes a little effort: a new word, a moment in history. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and slow rewards feel good again.

slides.texte_overlay:
a bedtime for your phone

put your phone to bed in another room one hour before you sleep. the last hour of the day decides how calm your mind is, and your sleep gets deeper almost straight away.

one full album

listen to one full album a week from start to finish, doing nothing else. sitting with one thing for forty minutes is hard at first, and that is exactly the training.
